senses.gloss: m., pl. constr. מוֹצָאֵי (b. h.; exit; מ׳ שבת (abbrev. מו״ש, מוצ״ש) the night following the Sabbath; מ׳ יו״ט the night following a Holy Day.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:5">Tosef. Sabb. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 15a">Ḥull. 15ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>יאכל במו״ש</he> (or <he>למו״ש</he>) may be eaten after the Sabbath is past.

<cite ref="Beitzah 30b:11">Bets. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 45a:4">Sabb. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>עד מ׳ יו״ט האחרון וכ׳</he> not before the end of the last day of the (Succoth) festival; a. v. fr.—<he>מ׳ שביעית</he> the period beginning with the end of the Sabbatical year.
